title: Pease Porridge Hot: Why Hot Cocoa Forms a Secret Skin on Top!

lines.text: Pease porridge hot, pease porridge cold, in the pot nine days old!
lines.caps: Pease porridge *HOT, | pease porridge *COLD, | in the pot *NINE | days *OLD!

lines.text: Have you ever seen that strange thin skin sitting on top of your warm hot cocoa?

lines.text: Don't worry, it's not plastic—it's pure kitchen science!

lines.text: Warm milk is packed with friendly proteins and tiny drops of healthy fat!

lines.text: As steam rises, water evaporates quickly from the very top surface!

lines.text: The milk proteins dry out and tangle together, forming a delicate edible blanket!

lines.text: Just stir it with a spoon or whisk, and it melts right back into chocolatey goodness!
